services.name: Voyageur Canoe
services.desc: Our Alta Lake Voyageur Canoe Tour is the perfect tour for families and groups. On this tour, a Whistler Eco Tours adventure guide will steer your eight-passenger Voyageur Canoe around beautiful Alta Lake. Absorb Whistler’s dramatic mountain views along the way. Learn about the history of Whistler and Canada while travelling the way the early settlers did. Voyageur Canoes are historical vessels of the Canadian fur trade, first used by French-Canadians in the 1600s. Looking for more family-friendly eco-tour options? services.name: Canoeing, Kayaking, SUP
services.desc: Choose to immerse yourself in Whistler’s natural beauty by joining one of our WET adventure guides on a guided canoeing or kayaking tour on Alta Lake with stunning views of Whistler and Blackcomb Mountain. On Alta Lake you can also Learn to Stand-Up Paddleboard or experience a traditional Voyageur Canoe Tour. Up for more of an adventure? A visit to Whistler would not be complete without a paddle down the River of Golden Dreams - our most popular tour and best in spring and early summer. Paddle across Whistler Wetlands and down the scenic glacial river aptly-named ‘The River of Golden Dreams’. services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: We rent canoes, single and double kayaks as well as stand-up paddleboards from our Alta Lake, Wayside Park location. Lifejackets/PDFs and paddles are included with all rentals. We take pre-bookings for half day and full day rentals. Hourly rentals are walk in only and will be rented on a first come first serve basis.

blurb: Whistler Eco Tours offers guided canoeing, kayaking, hiking, and mountain biking tours. Guests explore Whistler's flora, fauna, history, and geology with interpretive guides. Tours include paddling on Alta Lake and the River of Golden Dreams, hiking, and mountain biking.
extraNote: Tours begin at Wayside Park on Alta Lake and the Whistler Village Office at the Delta Hotel.
